title: DAY 4/90
MECHANICS
scenes.voice: Day four of the GATE M. E. ninety days challenge! One hundred and seven days to GATE. Today, impact problems stop being scary.

scenes.title: Today's Topic
scenes.voice: We are back to Engineering Mechanics. Today's topic: impulse, energy and impact.

scenes.title: Cover Today
scenes.voice: Cover linear and angular impulse-momentum, the work-energy method, collisions with the coefficient of restitution, and virtual work.

scenes.title: Quick Tip
scenes.voice: Quick tip. Impulse equals change in momentum. Restitution is separation speed over approach speed. Only when e equals one is no kinetic energy lost.

scenes.title: Today's Plan
scenes.voice: Grab the free practice set with full solutions on Telegram. Tonight's test runs seven to nine P. M. in our one rupee challenge course. Toppers in the next reel.
